title: Snap Fitness vs Jetts NZ — 24/7 Budget Gym Comparison 2026
meta_desc: Compare Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ prices, locations, and equipment for 24/7 gym access
intro: With over 100 locations across New Zealand, Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ are two of the most popular 24/7 budget gym chains. But which one offers better value for money? In this article, we'll compare their prices, equipment, and contract terms to help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: Overview of Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ offer 24/7 access to their gyms, with a range of equipment and group fitness classes. Snap Fitness has over 60 locations across NZ, while Jetts NZ has over 40 locations.

sections.heading: Equipment and Facilities
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ offer a range of cardio equipment, free weights, and strength training machines. However, Snap Fitness gyms tend to have more equipment and larger facilities, while Jetts NZ gyms are often more compact and focused on functional training.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ depends on your individual needs and preferences. If you're looking for a more extensive range of equipment and larger facilities, Snap Fitness may be the better choice. However, if you're on a tighter budget and prefer a more compact, functional training-focused gym, Jetts NZ could be the way to go.
